meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档内容拆成事实、解释、风险、行动四类卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在阅读资料后快速提炼出事实要点、潜在风险与可执行行动。
copy.tagline_en: Turn documents into fact, explanation, risk, and action cards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn reading notes into facts, risks, and next steps.

howto.what: 根据文档和你的问题，生成四张卡片：蓝卡给有出处的关键事实，绿卡给机制解释，黄卡给风险和偏差提示，红卡给下一步行动建议。
howto.when: 提供已解析的结构化文档并说明分析目标时触发，按事实、解释、风险、行动四步生成卡片。

say.text: 根据这份市场调研文档，帮我生成四色卡片。
say.note: 会依次输出蓝、绿、黄、红卡片。

say.text: 把这篇论文做成四色卡片，重点查结论有没有过度声明。
say.note: 黄卡会提示不确定性和潜在偏差。

say.text: 先抽取事实，再给出下一步行动建议。

howto.what_en: Based on the document and your question, it produces four cards: a blue card with sourced facts, a green card with mechanism/background explanation, a yellow card with risks and bias warnings, and a red card with suggested next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide a parsed structured document and state an analysis goal; it generates the cards in fact, explanation, risk, action order.

say_en.text: Generate the four color cards from this market research document.
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow, red cards in sequence.

say_en.text: Turn this paper into four color cards and check for overclaiming.
say_en.note: The yellow card flags uncertainty and bias.

say_en.text: First extract facts, then suggest next steps.
say_en.note: Maps to the blue and red cards.
